# DPS-v1 round 1 — independent structure, reuse, performance and CI-oracle review

## Subject and execution metadata

- Repository: `/workspace/scratch/29e7135d8bfe/fabushi-desktop`.
- Exact base: `8a4612e2042eefa32f12763c17141daabfd452e3`.
- Complete candidate tree: `6e120ddf1d716bda5938c8818be8e0ae6d2e69f4`.
- Fixed upstream identity declared by the batch and current lock: `1440bb1771372334bea23d7642bb52deb7db1845`, tree `90c8aab39972da11cfad220361781d49e1bc6700`.
- Manifest: `/workspace/scratch/29e7135d8bfe/reviews/dps-r1/manifest.json`.
- Applied worker configuration: `gpt-6.1-sol`, `xhigh`, explicitly selected by the parent invocation under the root AGENTS pinned reuse/structure/performance lens policy. This is an independent source assessment involving startup ordering, resource custody, persistence and evidence design; it is not a mechanical-only review. No model/effort fallback was reported to this worker.
- Source acquisition: immutable `git show`, `git grep`, `git ls-tree` and `git diff` against the identities above. No build, test, linter, generator, schema validation, benchmark, CI dispatch or other executable validation was run. No repository/index/ref/CI source was changed. This report is the sole written file.

I reviewed every changed hunk in all five manifest paths: `.github/workflows/rust-desktop-runtime.yml`; `projects/openclaw-rust/docs/specs/device-pairing-startup-durability.md`; `projects/openclaw-rust/requirements-traceability-matrix.json`; `source/host/app/src/main.rs`; and `source/host/app/tests/startup_admission_contract.rs`. The complete Git diff has exactly those five paths. I did not read author handoffs, other reviewer reports or runner decisions.

Authority/context read: root `AGENTS.md`; complete DPS-v1, HSA-v1 and `docs/specs/node-rpc-remote-presence.md`; the current Source of Truth's authority/implementation entry and constraints; applicable OCRM requirements, ownership, failure/evidence and latest §17 execution rules; relevant module-map startup/identity/Gateway/node/storage boundaries; and current upstream lock identities. Immutable tree enumeration found no nested AGENTS governing the changed paths.

Adjacent source coverage included `DevicePairingOwner` construction/schema setup and the exercised approval, rotation, revocation and token-authentication methods; actual `UnifiedAppHost`/`PlatformRequestHost` construction; Host lock release/Drop and physical-guard behavior; managed-daemon option admission; every production `device_pairing` use in `main.rs`; node registration/list/status/invoke projections; Gateway token authentication and role/scope enforcement; actual Gateway publication ordering; App Cargo declarations; and both changed workflow command/capture/receipt paths with their existing uploads. This was a bounded integration review, not an audit of all Host/FeatureHost internals or every upstream dependency.

## Findings

**No blocking or non-blocking defect found in the declared candidate scope.** No preference-only refactor, speculative cleanup or additional owner is requested.

## Basis for the source verdict

The production change is at the correct composition boundary. In candidate `main.rs:15211` onward, auxiliary roles still return before normal admission. The existing profile guard precedes managed layout and Host/Platform construction. The new durable pairing initialization at `main.rs:15280` follows those constructors and precedes managed daemon startup, `start_production_host_extensions`, the optional network supervisor, lifecycle telemetry construction and `start_gateway_server` (`main.rs:17126`). The managed-daemon stop used by the fixture originates in `BoxExecDaemonProcessOptions::from_process_env`: the non-loopback host is rejected before endpoint probing, executable lookup, directory creation or daemon spawn (`source/host/src/box/exec_daemon_process.rs:36`). Thus its exact diagnostic is a useful downstream control for this initializer.

The error branch emits the distinct pairing diagnostic, drops Platform then Unified Host then `host_lock`, and exits 1. At this location the later lifecycle-progress object does not exist (`main.rs:15449`). `HostLockHandle::Drop` invokes its existing release path, which removes its own PID projection before unlocking physical custody (`source/host/src/host_lock.rs:72`). The patch neither adds a custody owner nor changes takeover policy. The failed constructor's local owner/connection is released when its schema initialization returns an error. Constructor effects in other stores remain explicitly permitted by the DPS contract.

The same successful `Arc<DevicePairingOwner>` is moved into the existing `UnifiedGatewayApi` at `main.rs:16881`. The old late constructor/fallback is removed, and a production-source search found only the new `DevicePairingOwner::new` site. The existing explicit in-memory unit fixtures remain available. Pairing dispatch (`main.rs:3894`), remote registration and node projections (`main.rs:5062`, `5100`, `5201`, `5245`), device-token authentication (`main.rs:12801`) and join-code redemption (`main.rs:12848`) retain their existing owner. Gateway request authorization still consumes that authorization result and applies the existing role/scope/target checks. No second database, cache, registry, transport, retry queue or permission authority is introduced.

The durable initializer is invoked once on the healthy path, as before. Moving this existing SQLite connection earlier adds no new dependency, worker, poll, repeated open, query loop or steady-state work. Its connection lives through bootstrap into the same Gateway owner, rather than being reconstructed for consumers. This is a source-level cost assessment only; it makes no measured startup-latency, resource-budget or soak claim. Additional fixture work is bounded by the existing per-child/diagnostic/tree limits and remains in the existing integration target and cache lanes.

## Oracle and capture assessment

The fixture launches `env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_mahayana-app-host")`, with production FeatureHost selection, an environment allowlist, isolated app/profile/home/temp paths, null stdin and separately owned output files (`startup_admission_contract.rs:244`). It does not invoke a replacement main or test-only startup seam. Child exit is observed and reaped through the exact owned `Child`; a timeout, excess output or forced/uncertain retirement panics and cannot reach `finish` as passing evidence. These controls are reused without weakening the four existing HSA tests.

The three new named tests have causal oracles:

| Test | What its assertions decide |
| --- | --- |
| `pairing_store_failures_preserve_obstacles_and_release_profile_then_recover` (`:701`) | Both non-SQLite bytes and a directory with sentinel descendants survive refused and admitted startup. A held profile must win before pairing inspection; admitted failure requires exit 1 plus a nonempty pairing-specific error and excludes the downstream daemon error. The PID projection retires and a successor acquires the same guard. Repair moves only the owned obstacle, preserves it, and a subsequent real child reaches the exact daemon admission stop and creates the pairing schema. |
| `missing_pairing_store_is_created_before_daemon_and_reopened_on_restart` (`:750`) | The database starts absent. The actual binary must create all six expected pairing tables before reaching the daemon control, and repeat the control on restart. The schema observer is read-only and cannot manufacture that success. |
| `durable_pairing_tokens_and_revision_survive_real_startup_and_storage_recovery` (`:773`) | The shipping binary first creates the schema. The canonical file-backed owner then approves an identity and creates separate operator/node tokens. Close/reopen and controlled real startup preserve identity, role-scoped authorizations and revisions. Node rotation invalidates the old node token while retaining the operator token. An unavailable-store startup preserves the original backup and obstruction; restoration retains revision 4 and the valid replacement. Revocation persists at revision 5 and all prior tokens remain rejected after another startup. |

All owner/observer scopes close before child startup or the original database is renamed. The new read-only observers cannot create or repair the shipping schema. The token assertions use the actual owner's public methods and transaction-backed persistence, not a competing test schema. Restoring the former late fallback would fail the unhealthy-store diagnostic/status assertions and the first-creation-before-daemon control. Moving the initializer ahead of custody would fail the corrupt/directory held-profile control. These tests do not exercise pairing RPCs over a live Gateway; same-owner production integration is established by source tracing, and the receipt scope accurately states the runtime limit.

The macOS scoped path retains the existing `run_recovery_check` command, merged complete Cargo output file and command exit record. The new receipt (`rust-desktop-runtime.yml:637`) binds HEAD/tree to the scoped subject and `FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA`, requires one successful exit record for `app-startup-admission`, requires every old and new test name exactly once, and rejects missing/duplicate names, failed/ignored tests, absent summaries and zero-test runs. It hashes the input set and raw log and writes into the already uploaded recovery evidence directory. A receipt parser exception or failed command remains a failing step; earlier accumulated admission failures are preserved.

The Linux path (`rust-desktop-runtime.yml:2357`) reuses the existing App command helper and target cache, runs the same integration target serially, and applies the same required-name/nonzero/zero-failed/zero-ignored summary requirements. The helper separately captures stdout/stderr, records command exit and hashes both outputs; a nonzero command raises before acceptance. Its enclosing receipt binds the exact HEAD/tree/U and hashes the new spec, harness, owner, lock and build inputs. Existing always-run evidence upload preserves the receipt and logs, and failed owned fixtures are included in the existing native fixture retention path. Neither new path relies solely on Cargo's zero exit or on a source-string assertion.

The RTM diff adds evidence references only. It does not change global flags, acceptance states, authority or source-reading claims. The DPS spec explicitly keeps actual Actions, live device/Gateway transport and whole-project acceptance pending.

## Requirement disposition and limits

| Requirement | Source review disposition |
| --- | --- |
| DPS-01 | Conforms: durable initialization is required; normal startup has no transient replacement, store reset or success path after initialization failure. Healthy missing-store creation uses the existing owner. |
| DPS-02 | Conforms: placement is after existing guarded constructors and before downstream admission; auxiliary early branches are unchanged. |
| DPS-03 | Conforms: distinct error, exit 1, explicit owner/guard drops, no retry/repair/replacement or nonexistent lifecycle object. |
| DPS-04 | Conforms: a single successful owner feeds unchanged consumers and existing transactions/formats/policies. |
| DPS-05 | Source and proposed oracle conform: refusal precedes pairing; guard/PID retirement and same-guard successor acquisition are asserted. Actual execution remains pending. |
| DPS-06 | Proposed oracle conforms: actual child restart/control is combined with durable identity/token/revision checks and owned obstacle restoration. Actual execution remains pending. |
| DPS-07 | Proposed oracle conforms: shipping binary, intended diagnostic/status, downstream positive control and strict named-test receipts; timeout/cleanup cannot pass. Actual execution remains pending. |

Compilation was assessed from source and declared dependencies only. Existing direct dependencies already supply `DevicePairingOwner`, `serde_json`, UUID and the matching rusqlite API; the integration target is already part of the App package. I found no new source-visible type/build selection risk, but did not establish a compiler or linker result.

No CI outcome or artifact was adjudicated in this review. It does not prove full Host readiness, live Gateway/device compatibility, transaction-crash durability, all malformed historical SQLite schemas, external filesystem races, cross-profile custody, complete constructor-worker/process-tree retirement, physical devices, packaging, performance budgets or full OCRM acceptance. Those limits are not converted into successful or not-applicable gates.

**Final source verdict: APPROVE the frozen five-path DPS-v1 candidate for this structure/reuse/performance and CI-oracle lens, with zero findings. Executable verification and live-device acceptance remain pending.**

## Decision rationale

### Existing owner and transaction reuse

运行时实际 delta 只在 `device_pairing_owner.rs:bump_revision`（candidate line 119）内部。`OptionalExtension` 已在本 owner 使用和导入，现有锁定 rusqlite `0.39.0` 未变。`query_row(...).optional()?` 只把 absence 变为 `None`，SQL/value conversion 失败继续传播；已存在 TEXT 则使用同一 `trim_matches('"')` 与 `parse::<u64>()`，parse error 不再合成为零。仅 `None` 初始化为零，输出继续写 quoted decimal。`checked_add` 同时保留 MAX-1→MAX 并拒绝 MAX 后继，无新增 schema、dependency 或格式 owner。

三个生产调用仍传入同一事务：approval line 755、revoke line 906、rotate line 1007。各自先修改目标行、再 admission revision、再显式 commit，之后才构造 success JSON / 返回新 token。`?` 在 revision 错误处退出时仍持有未 commit 的 transaction，保留既有 rollback-on-drop 语义；新的错误未被转换成 success。测试通过同一 owner 再次调用与独立 SQL 读证明其可观察合同，不依赖 `current_revision()` 的旧 false-zero helper。该 helper 的生产调用未被新增，检索到的现有调用属于测试，故它不成为另一授权或 revision authority。

approval 在事务前 prune expired pending 是保留的既有副作用；spec 明确排除 whole-database byte immutability，新负例使用新鲜 pending 并对目标行与 revision 作比较，没有借测试把此副作用改写成事务保证。无法从 reopen 推出断电/crash/unknown-COMMIT 安全，spec 与 CI scope 都明确保留该边界。

### Production integration and build contracts

frozen DPS base 的 `source/host/app/src/main.rs` line 15376 以真实 `device-pairing.db` 建立单一 `Arc<DevicePairingOwner>`，初始化失败提前退出；同一实例被 UnifiedGatewayApi 持有。`call_openclaw_gateway_command` line 3897 把现有 pairing 方法直接交给 `handle_pairing_command`，token authentication 同样委托该 owner。Gateway 保留 operator/write 约束及 `GatewayCommandError::Internal` → status 500 / 现有错误 JSON 的投影。没有新 store、fallback owner、后台 retry、第二 revision source 或旁路成功消费者。

新增测试的 rusqlite、serde_json、uuid 均由现有 Host dependencies 提供；现有 integration-test 自动发现布局未变。Boxed parse error 与 io error 使用现有 rusqlite error variants，接口返回类型保持不变。Rust edition 2024、CI pinned toolchain 1.97.1 与 `std::io::Error::other` 的使用在声明层面无可见冲突。这是静态兼容判断，未替代一次真实 compile。

`revision_admission::Fixture` 在 UUID 专属目录建立真实 file-backed owner；observer 另开只读 SQLite connection（line 718），fault/repair writer 只更新该 fixture 的 revision（line 743）。`StoredState` 保留 raw SQL `Value`、`typeof(value_json)`、revision timestamp、该设备全部 pending/paired columns；它没有调用被修复的 helper 来推算预期 revision。

| DPR-01 | `pairing_revision_missing_and_legacy_decimal_counters_keep_monotonic_receipts`：fresh absence→1、next→2、raw/quoted/repeated-quote legacy decimal→42，成功前后与 reopen 均观察 durable rows。 |
| DPR-02 | `pairing_revision_refuses_corrupt_counters_without_committing_mutations`：nonnumeric TEXT、out-of-range TEXT、BLOB wrong SQL type 分别经 approve/revoke/rotate；错误必须为 Internal/500，且诊断不含持久化原文或旧 token。 |
| DPR-03 | 单独 last-increment 测试证明 MAX-1→MAX 的 receipt 与 durable row；MAX refusal 随三个 mutation 分别观察，panic 不被捕获当作正常拒绝。 |

这些负例对旧实现具备直接区分力：旧 parse/conversion→zero 会使非法 cell 返回成功，`expect_err` 失败；旧 MAX addition 在 checked profile 会 panic，在 unchecked profile 会返回成功，均不满足 test oracle。该判断来自源阅读，没有宣称已执行 mutation testing。

`.github/workflows/rust-desktop-runtime.yml` 新增 `device-pairing-revision` case（line 2131 附近）使用现有 Linux Host cache 执行 `cargo test --locked --manifest-path source/host/Cargo.toml --test device_pairing_contract -- --test-threads=1`，没有 filter 掩掉现有 suite。要求三条新增具名 tests 与原 approve/revoke/rotate 三条 controls 恰好各出现一次 `... ok`。
